tool_args.rationale: The prior attempt selected the supported three-parameter normalized before/after contrast law, but execution failed because fitted parameters were never initialized. This version assigns least-squares parameters in fit() and uses them in predict(), preserving the model while correcting the runtime error.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five varied rows identify the recalled three-parameter contrast-relaxation law; an additional paid batch is unnecessary.
Its dependence on x_now alone does not explain the opposing-step responses as directly as the observed before/after contrast signature.
It omits the recalled normalized equilibrium contribution and uses no independently fitted equilibrium term.
